designRationale.direction: A searchable semantic-model catalog that proves the governed provider path.
dataVisualisation: Searchable semantic-entity table and entity-type counts
responsiveBehaviour: Summary cards wrap and the semantic table scrolls horizontally on narrow screens.
accessibility: Labelled search input, semantic table headings, visible numeric counts, and a live connection status.
risks: Catalog rows prove the report-to-semantic-provider path; source refresh remains a separate deployment acceptance check.
